# Marky v1.8.6

A more capable local-first workspace with safer file handling, richer editing, and automatic sync options.

### Vault and attachments

- Added an attachment manager to find, preview, open, and remove files while showing which notes use them.
- Improved attachment indexing and usage tracking across the vault.
- Added safer clipboard and file-operation handling.

### Sync

- Added Git sync for vaults, including repository initialization, status, pull, commit, and push flows.
- Added automatic sync settings and a background sync runner.
- Expanded sync settings and workspace state handling.

### Editor and navigation

- Added interactive Markdown table editing.
- Improved live preview rendering, spacing, selection, and editor polish.
- Added multi-selection and more reliable tree operations in the sidebar.
- Improved command palette and settings integration.
